units.rawText: The color green symbolizes life. Just being surrounded by green plants every day greatly improves your mood.

units.rawText: I hope the vigor and exuberance of this place can sweep away your exhaustion and fill you with energy.

units.rawText: Please come here often when you have free time. I'll be waiting with the very best tea leaves and snacks.
